capabilities.title: Make a useful first step
capabilities.delivers: Prepares bounded guides, drafts and short games in the browser, without contacting anyone.
capabilities.requires: You choose whether to save or share; a draft does not fulfill the underlying need.

capabilities.title: Prepare a consented surplus handoff
capabilities.delivers: Inspects separately prepared surplus/quest records and can draft a limited postcard; not a live resource match.
capabilities.requires: Requires a source-owned offer, separate receiver, safe handling, and explicit human consent.

capabilities.title: Run a small community music or gathering activity
capabilities.delivers: Offers local, printable event tools and a voluntary hosting guide; no venue or artists automatically booked.
capabilities.requires: Host controls venue, accessibility, safety, attendance and rights.
